topic: Aave and static-aToken compiled source oracles and arithmetic corrections, 2026-09-28

facts.value: Current ReserveLogic._updateIndexes assigns the half-up accrued liquidity index through SafeCast.toUint128; getNormalizedIncome returns the wider uint256 projection without that narrowing.
facts.note: With index 2^128-1, rate RAY and one year elapsed, source projection succeeds with 2^129-2 but stored update gives the exact SafeCast custom error. Both stored fields fit uint128. Debt cache inputs are zero in the harness; outer updateState/treasury are outside scope.

facts.value: rayDivRoundDown computes a*RAY before division; rayDivRoundUp computes a*RAY, adds b and subtracts 1 before division. At zero denominator the first failure can be checked overflow or underflow instead of division by zero. Multiplication helpers explicitly return zero if either operand is zero.
facts.note: Compiled source controls distinguish Panic 0x11 from Panic 0x12. The host now follows that failure order and checks subtraction before a BigUint underflow.

facts.value: The selected v3.4.0 AToken.balanceOf uses half-up rayMul; its IncentivizedERC20 stores the holder basis as uint120, as does the selected current source. This is a specific older getter pin, not every historical revision.
facts.note: Both full base sources are preserved and asserted in the generator. Oracle adapters enforce uint120 holder inputs, uint128 reserve lanes and uint40 stored timestamps; pure helper operands and static shares remain uint256.

facts.value: The official macOS amd64 solc 0.8.27+commit.40a35a09 binary has SHA256 8c406fa5cab9bd0a175da02c652072f814c3d06205a2fd6d92bc152599a6aabb. The oracle explicitly compiles for Paris instead of current Aave's Shanghai setting.
facts.note: Whole original arithmetic/type libraries, license notices, dependency Gitlinks, exact extracted function substitutions, as-run generator, compiler flags and all generated hashes are retained. 5,103 source executions include exact success/error payload controls. No deployed compiler/runtime claim.

open_questions: Actual deployment/runtime/Pool dependency binding and reachability of extreme valid-width states remain unverified by source execution.
The harness does not execute mapping lookups, external calls, debt, treasury, full reserve updates, rewards, supply caps or deposit/withdraw transitions.
Current packaged output, initialized checkpoints, unobserved holders and dependency truth remain separately qualified; existing historical BSC reports are not extended.
